# ataila_brand_asset (Data Source)

One brand asset, by `id` or by `sha256` of its content.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_brand_asset" "logo" {
  sha256 = filesha256("${path.module}/brand/logo.png")
}

output "logo_url" {
  value = data.ataila_brand_asset.logo.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The asset's id. Give `id` or `sha256`.
- `sha256` (String) sha256 (lower-case hex) of the content. Give `id` or `sha256`.

### Read-Only

- `bytes` (Number) Size in bytes.
- `filename` (String) The file name recorded at upload.
- `height` (Number) Height in pixels, when known.
- `kind` (String) `logo` or `favicon`.
- `mime` (String) The media type.
- `uploaded_at` (String) When the asset was uploaded: RFC 3339 in UTC.
- `url` (String) Where the platform serves the file, readable without signing in.
- `width` (Number) Width in pixels, when known.
